Issue 4721 -- "Support applying clang fix-its automatically".

What to look at is the DIAGNOSTIC in each pane, not the DXIL.

  pane 1  dxc 1.6.2112   the last shipped release that diagnoses this
                         WITHOUT a suggested replacement: caret only.
  pane 2  dxc trunk      the same compile today. Under the caret, dxc now
                         prints the exact corrected source it wants. That
                         string is a clang FixItHint, computed by Sema.
  pane 3  dxc trunk      the same compile plus the flag this issue asks for.
                         The compiler that just printed the fix rejects the
                         request to apply it.

So the gap is not "dxc does not know the fix". It knows, and prints it, and
has no way to write it back. Ignore the banner line numbers: this comment
block shifts them relative to the repro tested locally.
